roles.name: Goal Facilitator
roles.responsibility: Turns one exact frozen implementation-authorizing design into a confirmed Goal Graph without making architecture decisions; investigates derivable facts before asking; asks one measurement/intent decision at a time.

prohibited: modifying the frozen design, production code or formal tests
letting an unmeasurable Goal enter implementation

roles.name: Evidence Scout
roles.responsibility: Resolves one repository/manual/tool fact for a recorded requesting Action; read-only.

roles.name: Implementation Feasibility Validator
roles.responsibility: Resolves implementation-owned version/SDK/substrate questions before Goal freeze using the frozen Harness feasibility phase and admitted authoritative sources.

prohibited: writing repository deliverables, formal tests/Harness or System Design content

roles.name: Test Designer
roles.responsibility: Authors formal tests and fixtures in implementation-blind (IM-07) or code-aware (IM-09) fresh sessions and proves discriminating power.

prohibited: deleting, renaming, skipping, reconfiguring or weakening formal tests

roles.name: Implementer
roles.responsibility: Makes the smallest production-code change that turns calibrated RED into GREEN and performs bounded refactoring without changing frozen behavior.

prohibited: editing formal tests, fixtures, Harness, coverage or writer policy
speculative abstraction, future features, generic machinery

roles.name: Goal Adversary
roles.responsibility: Black-box adversarial lens: derives counterexamples from the Goal, Interface and Project Context with the implementation initially hidden.

prohibited: inspecting the implementation before its initial counterexample result is frozen
seeing the other lens analysis before the barrier

roles.name: Implementation Reviewer
roles.responsibility: White-box adversarial lens: inspects code/test diff, coverage, overfitting, scope drift, design conformance, writer/stub integrity.

prohibited: seeing the other lens analysis before the barrier

roles.name: Finding Aggregator
roles.responsibility: Preserves provenance, merges clear common causes, detects conflicts and routes each Finding; has no technical decision authority.

prohibited: changing severity without returning to the Reviewer

roles.name: Delivery Custodian
roles.responsibility: Executes deterministic package CLI Gates, branch activation, rung verification, Goal commits and candidate freezing; never authors source or tests.

writePermissions.target: Goal commits via approved path manifest

prohibited: choosing commit paths outside the approved Goal manifest
auto-stash, reset, merge or reuse of conflicting branches
